name: Classgrove
summary: A teacher's dashboard for an online school: lessons, marking, a live class room and a class heatmap
about: A nine-page dashboard for a science teacher at an online college, in sunny yellow and slate on off-white with a slate night theme. A heatmap shows which student understood which lesson, and marking a paper on the rubric flips the card and sends the grade flying into the gradebook. Courses have a drag-and-drop lesson builder, and the live class room, calendar, messages and reports all work with demo data.
how: Open a page from the sidebar: Today, Courses, Students, Marking, Calendar, Live class, Messages, Reports or Settings
On Today, switch classes on the heatmap, hover a square to light up its row and lesson, and click it to change the level or plan a review
In Marking, pick a level in each rubric row and press Return grade to flip the paper and land the grade in the gradebook
In Courses, drag lesson blocks by their handle, change minutes and watch the time plan fill against the lesson length
Run the live class: share the slide, give the floor to raised hands, chat and close the poll to reveal the answer
Press Ctrl+K to jump to any page, student or lesson; reset the demo data in Settings
